name: Legacy Customer CRM Schema
description: Legacy mainframe/SQL export containing dirty, unstandardized customer records.

fields.name: legacy_account_id
fields.description: Primary natural key in legacy system (e.g. LEGACY-CUST-00101)

fields.name: full_name_raw
fields.description: Dirty names in mixed formats ('Doe, John', 'Jane Smith', 'Cher', empty)

fields.name: email_address
fields.description: Customer contact email, may contain mixed casing, trailing whitespace, or missing '@'

fields.name: phone_raw
fields.description: Raw phone strings with punctuation '(555) 123-4567', dots, or invalid short numbers

fields.name: signup_date_str
fields.description: Heterogeneous dates: 'MM/DD/YYYY', 'YYYY-MM-DD', 'Month DD, YYYY', epoch, or 'UNKNOWN'

fields.name: account_status_code
fields.description: Legacy integer status code: 1=ACTIVE, 0=INACTIVE, 9=TERMINATED, X=UNKNOWN, null

fields.name: country_code_raw
fields.description: Country names or abbreviations: 'USA', 'United States', 'CA', 'Canada', 'GB', 'UK', null
